text:
Priya S: Dropping a fresh mock for the Alerting -> Channels list. Trying a compact row layout (icon, name, small state pill) instead of big cards. Keeps vertical density for teams with many channels. Link: /design/alerts/compact-rows-v3 (staging). Evan G: Compact rows look great for scaling. Quick question: how do we surface per-channel threshold overrides? Inline? modal? Priya S: Thinking modal for editing thresholds so the list stays tidy. Quick inline indicator (e.g., "Override: 5m") visible on the row. Click opens modal. Hannah L: Modal is good, but can we make the threshold inputs keyboard-friendly? sliders are hard to input exact minutes. Maybe an input + +/- stepper with keyboard increments and aria live announcements. Carlos M: Accessibility: the green success pill has only 3:1 contrast on light theme. We need at least 4.5:1. Also role="status" for live updates could help for screen readers when thresholds change. Priya S: Noted — will darken the green and add role=status for the pill updates. Also thinking about suppression: current mock shows the suppression schedule inline, which pushes rows down. Alternative: "Manage suppression" opens a right-hand flyout with recurrence builder. Thoughts? Nina V: Flyout is my vote. Keeps list compact. Ensure focus trap and that pressing Esc closes the flyout and returns focus to the Manage suppression button. Hannah L: If we use flyout, show a minimal badge on the row like "Suppressed until 4:30pm" so collapsed view still communicates state. Mouse hover shows full schedule. Evan G: UX nit: Remove the word "channel" from row copy (e.g., "Email channel") — we already have a channel icon and grouping. Shorten to just the name. Priya S: Agree, shorter copy. Also ops asked to replace "Mute" with "Silence" across the product. Leaning toward "Silence" for consistency, but open to feedback. Carlos M: "Silence" is fine but we need a confirmation toast with exact range: "Email silenced until 4:30pm (Undo)". Also analytics event: silence.toggled with channel_id and duration. Nina V: On mobile, compact rows stack weirdly. Suggest making the rows single-column with a collapsed details panel and a "Preview" action pinned. Keep touch targets >= 44px. Priya S: Good call. Ill push a mobile variant. Also animation timing question: current expand/collapse is 250ms easing, feels sluggish on dense lists. Recommend 160ms. Hannah L: Copy tweak for threshold modal: change "Minimum interval" -> "Incident threshold (min frequency)" to be clearer. Evan G: For Test notifications flow, change "Send preview" to "Preview notification" and add an ARIA-friendly confirmation dialog when sending to live channels ("This will send a test to X recipients. Continue?"). Priya S: I'll add the confirmation and guard it behind a toggle for internal users. Snippet for row accessibility I'm adding to the doc: ```html
``` Carlos M: Also recommend adding a keyboard shortcut hint in the Row like "Press Enter to open" for discoverability. Nina V: One last a11y thing: color tokens for the pills should be configurable in themes; don't hardcode hex in component. DesignBot: Preview deployed to staging at /design/alerts/compact-rows-v3 (changeset #512). Please test with VoiceOver/NVDA. Priya S: Thanks all. Ill update the Figma with the modal pattern, flyout spec, and new color tokens. Will also include a microcopy doc for the "Silence" confirmation text and analytic events. Back with iteration tomorrow morning :sparkles:
